title: SDSS9 color
credit: Sloan Digital Sky Survey; color HiPS CDS/P/SDSS9/color by T. Boch (CDS), cut out by the CDS hips2fits service

geometryEvidence.reference: Leroy et al. (2021), PHANGS-ALMA, ApJS 257, 43, table of galaxies (orientations from Lang et al. 2020), row NGC3627: inclination 57.3 ± 1.0°, position angle 173.1 ± 3.6°. Which edge of the disc is nearer is not in the source: the disc is drawn with the edge at position angle 263° nearer, an assumption.

displayModel: The photograph lies on one flat plane, the disc's midplane, as the Milky Way's backing image does. The bulge of S4G's published fit, scaled to the photograph, fills a spheroid through that plane; its depth is modelled, not measured.
coverage: Milky Way foreground stars (Gaia DR3) are removed where they show; fainter and uncatalogued stars remain.

acquisition.operation: Request the cutout from the CDS hips2fits service: 3000 x 3000 px, 0.274 degrees wide, tangent projection on 170.062534, +12.991604, north up; no crop or resample.
